description: This is a rectangular rug with a black background adorned with a vibrant floral pattern. The flowers are depicted in various shades of red, orange, pink, and blue, with green leaves and stems scattered throughout. The rug has a textured appearance, suggesting it is woven from natural fibers. Along the edges, there is a decorative border featuring smaller floral motifs and geometric patterns in earthy tones like brown and beige. The rug is finished with a fringe on one of the shorter ends, composed of loosely hanging threads in a light beige color. The overall design is rich and intricate, giving it a traditional or bohemian aesthetic.
